66700.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of vācā

examples.text: akkodhano asantāsī, avikatthī akukkuco, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, sa ve vācāyato muni.
tathā hi pana maṃ, bhante, bhikkhū samantā vācāyasannitodakena sañjambharim'akaṃsū'ti.
atha kho te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāsattitodakena sañjambharimakaṃsu

tadā maṃ, bhante, te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato samantato vācāsannitodakena sañjhabbharim'akaṃsu, evam'eva pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ poṭṭhapādo yaññad'eva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati, taṃ tadev'assa abbhanumodati, evam'etaṃ bhagavā evam'etaṃ sugatā'ti.

66708.meaning1: baseless words; unfounded speech; groundless statement; (comm) based on words
66708.commentary: (SNa) vāc'āvatthukam'evassā'ti, vācāya vattabbavatthumattakam'eva bhaveyya. imāni pana dvādas'āyatanāni atikkamitvā ayaṃ nāma añño sabhāvadhammo atthī'ti dassetuṃ na sakkuṇeyya.

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, aham'etaṃ sabbaṃ paccakkhāya aññaṃ sabbaṃ paññāpessāmī'ti, tassa vāc'āvatthukam'ev'assa, puṭṭho ca na sampāyeyya, uttariñ'ca vighātaṃ āpajjeyya.

66709.commentary: (DNa) vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjatī'ti vācāya vikkhepaṃ āpajjati. kīdisaṃ? amarāvikkhepaṃ, apariyantavikkhepan'ti attho.

examples.text: tatra, sandaka, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā mando momūho. so mandattā momūhattā tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ, evan'ti'pi me no, tathā'ti'pi me no, aññathā'ti'pi me no, no'ti'pi me no, no no'ti'pi me no'ti.

66724.commentary: (SNa) divase divase sammaṃ khipitvā tassa patit'okāse vediṃ katvā saṃhārimehi yūp'ādīhi sarassatinadiyā nimugg'okāsato pabhuti paṭilomaṃ gacchantena yajitabbassa satrayāgass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. vājam'ettha pivantī'ti vājapeyyo.

examples.text: assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.
na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ kaṇḍaṃ jānāmi yen'amhi viddho, yassa pattehi vājitaṃ yadi vā gijjhassa yadi vā kaṅkassa yadi vā kulalassa yadi vā morassa yadi vā sithilahanuno'ti

66727.commentary: (DNa) puratthimena yaññavāṭassā'ti puratthimato nagaradvāre dānasālāya puratthimabhāge. yathā puratthimadisato āgacchantā khattiyānaṃ dānasālāya yāguṃ pivitvā rañño dānasālāya bhuñjitvā nagaraṃ pavisanti. evarūpe ṭhāne paṭṭhapesuṃ. dakkhiṇena yaññavāṭassā'ti dakkhiṇato nagaradvāre dānasālāya vuttanayen'eva dakkhiṇabhāge paṭṭhapesuṃ.

examples.text: pacchimena yaññavāṭassa brāhmaṇamahāsālā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ. uttarena yaññavāṭassa gahapatinecayikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ.
kassako kammunā hoti, sippiko hoti kammunā, vāṇijo kammunā hoti, pessiko hoti kammunā.
attā hi attano nātho, attā hi attano gati, tasmā saññamay'attānaṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃ'va vāṇijo.
atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, kiṃ nu kho, āvuso ānanda, ahaṃ sūcivāṇijako, tvaṃ sūcikāro, udāhu ahaṃ sūcikāro, tvaṃ sūcivāṇijako'ti?

66731.commentary: (MNa) vāṇij'ūpamā maññe'ti vāṇij'ūpamā viya vāṇijapaṭibhāgā vāṇijasadisā mayhaṃ upaṭṭhahanti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma vāṇijassa vāṇijjāya gacchato evaṃ hoti, ito me idaṃ bhavissati, iminā idaṃ lacchāmī'ti, evam'ev'ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā vāṇij'ūpamā maññe paṭibhanti, iti pecca bhavissāma, iti pecca bhavissāmā'ti.

seyyathā'pi nāma vāṇijassa vāṇijjāya gacchato evaṃ hoti, ito me idaṃ bhavissati, iminā idaṃ lacchāmī'ti, evam'ev'ime bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā vāṇijūpamā maññe paṭibhanti, iti pecca bhavissāma, iti pecca bhavissāmā'ti.

atha naṃ āha, amma, kāḷi imasmiṃ nagare pañca sakaṭasatāni paccūsakāle uṭṭhāya vāṇijjāya gacchanti, tvaṃ imaṃ netvā cakkamagge nipajjāpehi, goṇā vā naṃ maddissanti, cakkā vā chindissanti, pavattiṃ c'assa ñatvāva āgaccheyyāsī'ti.
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pathaviyā lekhā khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati. so ca khv'assa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.

66741.commentary: (JAa) vātajavappahārino'ti vātajavena gantvā paccāmitte paharaṇasīlā evarūpā aṭṭhasahassanāgā nāgarājānaṃ rakkhanti.

examples.text: agghāpetvā vātajavaṃ, sindhavaṃ sīghavāhanaṃ, padum'uttarabuddhassa, khamanīyam'adās'ahaṃ.

66755.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.7) vātavuṭṭhisamayo nāma bhikkhū sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti, dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni kāye patitāni honti, vātavuṭṭhisamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ

66766.commentary: (DHPa) ten'eva kāraṇena vāti devesu uttamo'ti pavaro seṭṭho hutvā devesu ca manussesu ca sabbattham'eva vāyati, ottharanto gacchatī'ti.

66775.meaning1: suffering from gas; ill with gastritis
66775.commentary: (SNa) vātehī'ti udaravātehi. bhagavato kira chabbassāni dukkarakārikaṃ karontassa pasatamuggayūs'ādīni āhārayato dubbhojanena c'eva dukkhaseyyāya ca udaravāto kuppi. aparabhāge sambodhiṃ patvā paṇītabhojanaṃ bhuñjantassā'pi antar'antarā so ābādho attānaṃ dasseti'y'eva. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: sāvatthinidānaṃ. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā vāteh'ābādhiko hoti, āyasmā ca upavāṇo bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti. atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ āmantesi, iṅgha me tvaṃ, upavāṇa, uṇh'odakaṃ jānāhī'ti.

66776.meaning1: holding a belief; having a doctrine

examples.text: akiriyavādo bhavaṃ gotamo'ti

ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ ukkalā vassabhaññā ahetukavādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā, te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti.

66777.meaning1: speech; statement; assertion; what is said

examples.text: yena naṃ vajjuṃ puthujjanā, atho samaṇabrāhmaṇā, taṃ tassa apurakkhataṃ, tasmā vādesu n'ejati.
yam'āhu dhammaṃ paraman'ti eke, tam'eva hīnan'ti pan'āhu aññe, sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabb'eva h'īme kusalā vadānā.
na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti
vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
tañ'ce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvattikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne, ko pana vādo bhiyyo, na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi
ekissā'pi, bhante, sattiyā haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha, ko pana vādo tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno'ti!
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso daliddo'va samāno aḍḍhavādaṃ vadeyya, adhano'va samāno dhanavāvādaṃ vadeyya, abhogo'va samāno bhogavāvādaṃ vadeyya.
evam'pi viggayha vivādayanti, bālo paro akusalo'ti c'āhu, sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabb'eva h'īme kusalā vadānā.
santi, bhante, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kesamuttaṃ āgacchanti. te sakaṃ'y'eva vādaṃ dīpenti jotenti, parappavādaṃ pana khuṃsenti vambhenti paribhavanti omakkhiṃ karonti.
te pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharonti, imaṃ mayaṃ pañhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchissāma. evaṃ ce no puṭṭho evaṃ byākarissati, evam'assa mayaṃ vādaṃ āropessāma.

66791.meaning1: defence of one's position; doctrinal rebuttal
66791.commentary: (MNa) vādapaṭihāran'ti paccāgamanakavādaṃ. ettāvatā tesaṃ apanetha saddhaṃ, sabbadubbalā esā'ti saddhāchedakavādaṃ nāma dasseti. (MNt) paṭiharati paṭivattetī'ti paṭihāro, vādo eva paṭihāro vādapaṭihāro, taṃ, uttaran'ti attho. ten'āha, paccāgamanakavādan'ti, codanaṃ parivattetvā paṭipākatikakaraṇan'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃvādī kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhesu na kañci sahadhammikaṃ vādapaṭihāraṃ samanupassāmi.

66792.meaning1: modes of expression; ways of speaking; linguistic concepts
66792.commentary: (NIDD2) samūhatā vādapathā'pi sabbe'ti vādapathā vuccanti kilesā ca khandhā ca abhisaṅkhārā ca. tassa vādā ca vādapathā ca adhivacanāni ca adhivacanapathā ca nirutti ca niruttipathā ca paññatti ca paññattipathā ca ūhatā… (MNa) anāgataṃ vādapathan'ti ajja ṭhapetvā sve vā punadivase vā aḍḍhamāse vā māse vā saṃvacchare vā tassa tassa pañhassa upari āgamanavādapathaṃ.

examples.text: atthaṅ'gatassa na pamāṇam'atthi, yena naṃ vajjuṃ taṃ tassa n'atthi, sabbesu dhammesu samohatesu, samūhatā vādapathā'pi sabbe'ti.

puna caparaṃ, udāyi, mamaṃ sāvakā adhipaññāya sambhāventi, paññavā samaṇo gotamo paramena paññākkhandhena samannāgato, taṃ vata anāgataṃ vādapathaṃ na dakkhati, uppannaṃ vā parappavādaṃ na sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggaṇhissatīti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

66793.meaning1: kind of doctrine; religious belief; belief system

examples.text: ye kec'ime vādapathā puthussitā, yaṃ nissitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, tathāgataṃ patvā na te bhavant, visāradaṃ vādapath'ātivattaṃ.

66794.meaning1: gone beyond doctrines; transcended belief systems

examples.text: ye kec'ime vādapathā puthussitā, yaṃ nissitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, tathāgataṃ patvā na te bhavanti, visāradaṃ vādapath'ātivattaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, ummujjamānakaṃ'y'eva mahatā pāsena bandheyya, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, ummujjamānako'y'eva bhagavatā mahatā vādapāsena baddho'ti.

66796.meaning1: saving an argument; rescuing a thesis
66796.commentary: (SNa) cara vādappamokkhāyā'ti taṃ taṃ ācariyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā uttari pariyesanto imassa vādassa mokkhāya cara āhiṇḍāhi.

examples.text: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
na itivādappamokkha-ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti.

66797.commentary: (NIDD1) idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayantī'ti… idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti vādayanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantī'ti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti.

examples.text: idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
gacchām'ahaṃ, bhante, samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropessāmī'ti gantvā mahatā'si vādasaṅghāṭena paṭimukko āgato.

66799.meaning1: refutes the doctrine; counters an argument; challenges a theory

examples.text: te pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharonti, imaṃ mayaṃ pañhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchissāma. evaṃ ce no puṭṭho evaṃ byākarissati, evam'assa mayaṃ vādaṃ āropessāma.
te bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ vā puccheyyuṃ vādaṃ vā āropeyyuṃ akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ.
